title: Dashboard Editor Improvements & Quick Creation
description: Enhanced the dashboard editing experience with a wider modal layout, quick dashboard creation from visualizations, and improved validation.
highlights: Significantly wider dashboard element editor for better usability
Create new dashboards directly from visualization preview
Smarter size controls that only appear when relevant
Improved validation prevents invalid chart type conversions

items.title: Expanded Dashboard Element Editor
items.description: The editor modal is now much wider and better utilizes large screens.
details: Modal width increased to 95% of viewport (up to 95vw)
Editor controls now occupy 60% of modal width for better spacing
Preview panel takes 40% with optimized layout
Form inputs and controls no longer feel cramped
Better visual hierarchy with increased gap spacing

items.title: Quick Dashboard Creation
items.description: Create new dashboards on-the-fly while exploring your data.
details: New '+ Create New Dashboard...' option in visualization preview dropdown
Simple modal prompts for dashboard name
Automatically adds the current visualization to the new dashboard
Seamless workflow from query to dashboard without leaving the page

items.title: Contextual Size Controls
items.description: Size toggles now only appear when they're actually useful.
details: Small/Medium/Large buttons only show for statistic elements
Charts auto-scale based on dashboard grid size
Cleaner preview interface for chart elements

items.title: Chart Type Conversion Validation
items.description: Prevents invalid conversions that would break visualizations.
details: Cannot convert multi-value charts to single-value stats
Clear error message explains why conversion isn't possible
Dropdown automatically reverts to previous valid type
Suggests creating a new stat element instead
